oracle_correction.reason: Frozen extractor rejected both valid direct-to-helper/destructuring refactors. Only expression/binding extraction changed; the same 25 behavior assertions and source fixture cases apply. No agent reruns or task fixes.

measurement_notes.comparison: Access/intention-to-treat pilot, not forced Graphify usage; one pair per task.
measurement_notes.time: Agent wall time includes CLI initialization/tools, excludes evaluator checks and prebuild; cold total adds per-fixture prebuild.
measurement_notes.tokens: Provider inputTokens includes cache read/write; do not add cache fields again. Reasoning tokens remain provider-reported.
measurement_notes.cost: totalNanoAiu / 1e9 gives provider AI credits. Monetary cost unavailable; legacy premium-request cost is not money or AI credits.
measurement_notes.memory: GNU time maximum RSS is not aggregate simultaneous process-tree RSS. Cgroup memory peak includes file cache.
measurement_notes.reproducibility: Model ID is not immutable; sampling/output settings and provider caching not fully controllable. Local OCI image ID frozen, byte-identical future image rebuild not guaranteed.
measurement_notes.trial_scope: 16 paid source trials only, no reruns. Source-free preflight cost excluded. Maintenance is model-free.
